fields.label: Paper Name
fields.description: e.g. Ivory, SBS Board, Art Paper. Matched against the Substrate field on a Print Estimate.

fields.label: GSM
fields.description: Same paper name can have several weights, each its own record and its own real rate (heavier stock isn't just a linear multiple of a lighter one in real pricing).

fields.label: Rate per Tonne
fields.description: What the mill/supplier charges per tonne for this specific paper name + weight.

fields.label: Reems & Sheets Conversion
fields.description: How this paper's own trade unit converts to a per-sheet cost - confirmed directly from the estimator, not assumed. This is deliberately NOT calculated from weight/area alone, since real reem sizes follow trade convention per paper type, not just physics.

fields.label: Sheets per Tonne (computed)
fields.description: Reems per Tonne x Sheets per Reem - filled in automatically.

fields.label: Cost per Sheet (computed)
fields.description: Rate per Tonne / Sheets per Tonne - filled in automatically. This is the number that actually feeds every estimate using this paper.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Where this rate came from and how confident we are in it.
